approval_scope: Complete TaskFlow Group 13 decision record as presented

requirements.decision: Declare runtime versions, dependencies, configuration, required services, and deployment assumptions. This is a reproducibility requirement, not a mandate to use a particular technology stack.
Use pinned dependencies and lockfiles, or equivalent immutable dependency records, so builds do not silently resolve to changing versions.
Validate required configuration at startup; inject secrets through protected configuration mechanisms; never commit credentials or leak secrets into logs or evidence.
Document build and start commands, preserve build inputs and integrity records, and make builds deterministic where feasible.
Document durable storage, migration ordering, backup/recovery expectations, and safe persistence across process or container replacement where persistence is promised.
Document differences among development, test, and deployment environments. Local-only success does not establish deployment verification.
Define startup/shutdown behavior, health/readiness expectations, interruption recovery, and failure handling.
Independently repeat build and deployment-smoke checks; preserve logs and relevant digests; mark simulated, unexecuted, or otherwise unsupported claims honestly.

notes: This record records approval expressed in chat only.
It is not a cryptographic signature or trusted evidence envelope.
Approval of requirements does not establish implementation, deployment, runtime behavior, or certification.
No specific framework, language, database, hosting provider, or deployment stack is mandated by this decision.
